payload.note: Exact additive-flow rate obstruction: on the replicated axial family Omega_m=(x,x^-3,x^-3,x^-3,x,x^7), x=2^m, the certified unnormalized additive contraction has relative action-decay rate asymptotic to 4/x and its bounded normalized version to 4/(3x^4), so neither has a field-uniform exponential rate even at fixed volume. The ordinary Euclidean action-gradient quotient instead grows as 3x^12, proving this is not a low-Rayleigh or almost-stationary BT family. Contractibility alone is retired as a quantitative Poincare input; the actual gradient quotient, Witten bridge, conditional current susceptibility, and interacting H^-1 estimate remain open.
